title: Sancta Trinitas (Jachet)
desc: Jachet of Mantua, Sancta Trinitas. 8 voices (Superius I, Superius II, Altus I, Altus II, Tenor I, Tenor II, Bassus I, Bassus II), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
